rules.text: a template matches only with supplied root radicals filling R1..R3 in order (no root derivation in the consumer)
mu_participle without a known penult vowel -> abstain penult_vowel_unknown (never default to active)
gloss SHAPE is nominal for every class here; the consumer flags (does not author) any verbal-gloss pairing
zero or >1 surviving template -> abstain (ambiguous_template or no_template)

every realization of a weak radical is licensed per template, slot and radical by weak_realizations.by_template: an altered letter must appear in that entry's substituted list, and a weak radical may stand literally only where literal_licensed is true; nothing is licensed by default
a claimed penult surface mark must be verifiable on the written surface: unpointed -> penult_mark_not_in_surface; differing written mark -> penult_mark_mismatch (never trust the claim alone)

every weak radical of the matched template requires the exact bound declaration (weak_position + weak_radical) -> otherwise weak_declaration_unbound; an unlicensed realization -> weak_realization_unlicensed
a weak declaration that the supplied radicals do not bear is contradictory evidence, not a harmless extra -> weak_declaration_contradicts_root

مَفْعَل (place/time noun) and the مُـ participle are letter-identical whenever the radicals stand literally after the initial مـ; the discriminator is the WRITTEN vowel on THAT initial مـ -- damma licenses the participle reading, fatha RULES OUT the participle reading (it does not by itself license place_time_noun; see der-r10) -- never the penult vowel, which only ever decides voice WITHIN the participle reading -> missing (initial_mim_mark_not_in_surface) or neither-damma-nor-fatha (initial_mim_vowel_unlicensed) written evidence abstains rather than silently dropping the co-surviving mafal_place template (repair of the recorded 2026-08-03 false positives)

a written fatha on the initial مـ over the same bare-triliteral literal-radical shape does not by itself distinguish مَفْعَل (place/time noun) from مصدر ميمي (مـ-initial verbal noun): masdar_mimi is declared here as a rival template sharing mafal_place's exact shape, so the fatha branch preserves BOTH mafal_place and masdar_mimi as alternatives (ambiguous_template) rather than resolving place_time_noun alone (mirrors mim-r6 in inc-mim-initial-noun-discriminator; repair of the recorded 2026-08-03 masdar_mimi collapse -- the mafal_place/mu_participle collision repair (der-r9) had performed, for this evidence set, exactly the single-resolution collapse the sibling pack's own repair had just ruled out)
